name: huge-step-order-survives
why: A step order beyond Int range must not be fatal. On macOS this was a TRAP, not a throw — the process died on decode, and because Home scans every project one bad file could stop the app launching at all. Windows passes the value through, so such a manifest round-trips there and crashed here.
note: The stored order is deliberately NOT asserted: macOS clamps to Int.max, Windows keeps 1e21. What both must guarantee is that the manifest still decodes and the step survives.
